en.answer: You cannot. You must control a "Yosenju" monster other than that <<11473>> in your Monster Zone to activate the effect.
en.question: If <<11476>> exists in my Pendulum Zone, can I activate the effect of <<11473>> which targets 1 card the opponent controls and returns it to the hand, if I control no other "Yosenju" monsters?
